reply_text: Sofia, the lamp delivery at door 6 was on **Pellow** (Pellow Home Living), not Pellucid. Pellow is the Mid-Atlantic home goods retail account. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account, which is why the two kept getting mixed up under "PHL." This is from the #coastal-team thread on 17 Feb, where you and Kwame sorted it out and agreed to relabel the saved views.
